parameters.jsCode:
const predictions = $input.all().map(item => item.json);

const sources = $('เตรียมข้อมูล ETA อัตโนมัติ')
  .all()
  .map(item => item.json);

return predictions.map((prediction, index) => {

  const source = sources[index] || {};

  return {
    json: {
      record_id:
        `${source.bus_id || prediction.route_id || "BUS"}_${Date.now()}_${index}`,

      bus_id:
        source.bus_id || "",

      route_id:
        prediction.route_id ||
        source.route_id ||
        "",

      current_stop_name:
        source.current_stop_name ||
        "",

      destination_stop_name:
        source.destination_stop_name ||
        "",

      distance_km:
        Number(
          prediction.distance_km ??
          source.distance_km ??
          0
        ),

      speed_kmh:
        Number(
          prediction.speed_kmh ??
          source.speed_kmh ??
          0
        ),

      hour:
        Number(
          prediction.hour ??
          source.hour ??
          new Date().getHours()
        ),

      day_of_week:
        prediction.day_of_week ||
        source.day_of_week ||
        "",

      predicted_eta_minutes:
        Number(
          prediction.predicted_eta_minutes ?? 0
        ),

      timestamp:
        source.timestamp ||
        new Date().toISOString()
    }
  };
});
